name: Understand Anything
summary: A Claude Code plugin that analyzes a project with several cooperating agents and builds a knowledge graph of its files, functions, classes and dependencies. It then opens an interactive dashboard for browsing the graph, searching it, and viewing guided tours. A separate command can also map a markdown knowledge base.
install_steps: See the repository README for install steps
example_use_case: You join a team with a large, unfamiliar codebase and want a visual map of how the parts connect, plus plain-English summaries, before reading any code.
